The Verification and Payment Committee on Gratuity announced the completion of the payment in Sokoto on Monday 16th November, 2026
Secretary of the Committee and Deputy Accountant-General of the state, Alhaji Junaidu Usman Junaidu, said thousands of retirees had waited for years without success, a situation that threw many families into severe economic hardship.
He said on assumption of office, Governor Aliyu inherited a huge backlog of unpaid gratuity and immediately approved N500 million monthly for the payment of the inherited arrears.
Three months later, the governor further approved an additional N300 million monthly for the payment of entitlements of those who retired from January 2024 to date.
According to Junaidu, verification confirmed that a total of 4,911 beneficiaries were paid:
Living Retirees: 3,183 persons — over N11.687 billion, Deceased Retirees: 926 persons — over N2.978 billion, Contract Gratuity:* 802 persons — over N197.148 million
He described the feat as a clear testimony of good leadership and commitment to the welfare of the people.
Junaidu said the completion of the inherited N14.86 billion arrears, coupled with the continued release of N300 million monthly for new retirees, is a major sign of good governance, accountability and care for the well-being of the people.
He commended Governor Aliyu for his vision, generosity and commitment to ensuring the welfare and payment of entitlements of serving and retired civil servants in the state.
